implemented_requirements.evidence: dice.py defines a Dice class with roll(), total and is_doubles properties.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board definition with properties and special spaces
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py builds a 40‑space board, creates Property objects, Chance spaces, Tax, Jail, Free Parking, Go‑to‑Jail.
chance.py defines ChanceCard and ChanceDeck with a shuffled list of cards and a draw() method.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player model with money, position, property ownership, jail state
implemented_requirements.evidence: player.py implements Player with money, position, properties list, in_jail flag, get_out_of_jail_cards, etc.

implemented_requirements.requirement: User interface for prompts and status display
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.py provides banner, show_message, turn_header, show_roll, show_status, and safe input helpers.
game.py defines Game.play(), play_round(), and play_turn() with a loop over players and rounds.
No code in the provided files asks a player to purchase a landed property or transfers ownership.
Game.resolve_space (which would handle rent) is referenced but not defined.
ChanceDeck is instantiated, but no code draws or applies a card when a player lands on a Chance space.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Jail mechanics (going to jail, paying fine, using Get Out of Jail card, rolling doubles)
implemented_requirements.evidence: handle_jail method is incomplete (contains ellipsis) and Game.send_to_jail is called but not defined.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Free Parking pot accumulation and payout
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.free_parking_pot exists, but no logic adds to it or pays it out.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display of relevant game information and player decisions
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.show_status, turn_header, show_message, and prompt_* functions are present.

critical_issues: Missing implementations for Game.move_player, Game.resolve_space, and Game.send_to_jail – core mechanics for movement, property interaction, and jail handling are absent.
handle_jail method is incomplete (contains only an ellipsis), so jail decisions cannot be processed.
No code to prompt a player to buy a property or to collect rent from other players.
Chance cards are never drawn or applied when a player lands on a Chance space.
Free Parking pot is never updated or awarded.
Potential NameError for undefined methods (e.g., self.send_to_jail) will cause runtime crashes.
The game loop may enter infinite loops or terminate early due to missing break conditions in incomplete methods.
judge.summary: The repository contains the skeleton of a Monopoly‑style game: board layout, dice, chance deck, player model, and UI helpers are implemented. However, the essential gameplay logic—moving players, buying properties, paying rent, applying chance cards, and full jail rules—is missing or incomplete. Consequently, the program would not run correctly and fails to meet the core functional requirements. The overall functional completeness is low and the likelihood of successful execution is minimal, leading to a failing verdict.
